props.Description: A brigandine is a cloth or leather coat lined with small internal plates, giving solid protection without the full presence of plate harness. It suits practical battlefield use where protection matters more than silence. In play, it offers @1547[1de|2da]{Brigandine Defense} while its traits emphasize noisy.
